about: What people who are not soldiers can wear: tools/spec.js writes this from js/rig.js. options: each option and its values. colours: the names of their colours. people: by character - wear (as it comes), palette, body (its parts, by joint name; tag: the option a part belongs to, ck: its colour by name), at (where a kit's parts come in the draw order), props (by kit).
